headline: Duration Gold and China Railway Sign $600M Gold Project Deal
summary: Duration Gold Limited and China Railway Resources Group signed an MOU exceeding $600 million to develop four large-scale gold projects in Zimbabwe.
why: Large foreign direct investments in mining projects significantly impact regional commodity extraction output and foreign exchange reserves in developing economies.

impacts.name: Zimbabwe
impacts.why: Inflows of over $600 million in mining capital investment support local infrastructure and gold production capacity.
